definitions.gloss: vice-chairperson; vice-president (of an organization or association)
definitions.explanation: The person second in rank to the chairperson of an organization, committee, or association. Assists the chairperson and acts in their absence.

examples.japanese: {副会長|ふくかいちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
{副会長|ふくかいちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}した→挨拶する：01797_aisatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The vice-chairperson gave the greeting in place of the chairperson.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{副会長|ふくかいちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are two candidates for next year's vice-chairperson.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧ (vice-, deputy) + ⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧ (chairperson, president of an organization). Used for organizations, committees, and associations — not for corporate vice-presidents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副会長|ふくかいちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to assume the position of vice-chairperson
- {副会長|ふくかいちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as vice-chairperson
- {副会長|ふくかいちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選出|せんしゅつ}される→選出する：17345_senshutsusuru⟧: to be elected vice-chairperson

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧: chairperson, president — the top position in an organization
- {副社長|ふくしゃちょう}: vice-president (of a company) — the corporate equivalent
- {副委員長|ふくいいんちょう}: vice-committee chair — for committees specifically
